mapper.sql: SELECT n.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit, s.name AS supplier_name, o.wo_no, i.insp_no, r.wo_no AS rework_wo_no, u.nickname AS create_by_name FROM qms_ncr n JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = n.material_id LEFT JOIN scm_supplier s ON s.id = n.supplier_id LEFT JOIN mes_work_order o ON o.id = n.wo_id LEFT JOIN mes_inspection i ON i.id = n.inspection_id LEFT JOIN mes_work_order r ON r.id = n.rework_wo_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = n.create_by
